title: Embedded Systems and Microcontrollers
lead: Covers lectures 01 and 02: what an embedded system is, sensors-processor-actuators, constraints, evolution and the shift to software, components, microprocessor vs microcontroller, core microcontroller components, I/O ports, programming flow, word size, the AVR family, ATmega328P and the Arduino Uno. Built from the lecture slides and the peer class notes.
